calls.title: Medha Umarji and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Fanatics is transitioning its experimentation program from a centralized to a decentralized model, aiming for a maturity rating of 3.5 out of 5. The goal is to facilitate thousands of experiments monthly, similar to Booking.com, which presents challenges due to current infrastructure limitations. The team is investing heavily in scalable experimentation infrastructure and AI integration, although AI will not fully orchestrate the process. Strict validation processes are in place to ensure experiment reliability, with a documented meta-analysis driving iterative learning. The experimentation program has contributed approximately $250 million in annual revenue, forming about 8% of total commerce revenue, with a culture built around learning from failures and improving data insights despite ongoing data limitations.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Infrastructure, Revenue impact, Meta-analysis, Customer lifetime value, Executive buy-in
